The Whippy Public API is a RESTful API for the Whippy AI customer communication platform. It uses standard HTTP methods and JSON request / response bodies and is authenticated with an API key supplied in the X-WHIPPY-KEY header (OAuth bearer tokens are also supported). The API covers messaging (SMS / MMS, email, fax), contacts, conversations and messages, campaigns, automated sequences, channels, and webhook / custom events.
